title: PropertyGraphReference
description: Id path of a property graph.

propertyGraphId.description: Required. The ID of the property graph. The ID must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), or underscores (_). The maximum length is 256 characters.

projectId.description: Required. The ID of the project containing this property graph.

datasetId.description: Required. The ID of the dataset containing this property graph.
